digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation confirmation and output standardization
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs following Unix silence rule cannot distinguish between silent success and idempotent no-op on stdout, causing agents to issue spurious follow-up reads and retries.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a single one-line kubectl-style confirmation on success (past-tense verb + args summary), with no-op cases printing 'no change: <reason>' instead, exiting 0 in both paths.

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the top-level router before verb dispatch to cover positional-only _REGISTRY leaves that treat option-looking tokens as errors, with --quiet suppressing only confirmation lines and --output json nesting outcome as structured field.

link's existing REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical on write and no-op paths including under --quiet, printing exactly one stdout result per invocation with no additional confirmation line overlaid.

Consumed seam returns (e.g., add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged in type and meaning; parallel outcome signaling added only where the existing return cannot distinguish writes from no-ops.

Confirmations must print to stdout while logs remain on stderr; existing exit-code contracts and verbs already printing (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) normalized to uniform message contract with zero information loss.
